text:
maria: opened PR to fix batching + KV-cache hot path (race when prefetch + evict coincide). need one approval to merge before today's deploy window. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4927  breve: if prefetch triggers eviction we can drop a live kv entry and then attempt to read it from the batch, causing OOB. added a small sync around the prefetch evict path and a microbenchmark. cc @alex @cheng

alex: looking now. quick skim — curious about the lock granularity. left an inline comment about holding the batch_lock across async prefetch callbacks. might be safer to use a per-shard spin/seqnum instead of global lock.

cheng: I can run the kv-cache perf job locally and repro the regression case. do we have a minimal repro in tests?

maria: added a unit test that simulates concurrent prefetch + evict (see test_kv_prefetch_eviction in kv_cache_test.cc). test is small but deterministic on my laptop. pushed another commit with the test and a comment explaining the seqnum idea.

alex: saw the test, runs fast. left one nit: in batcher.cc you do:```cpp
if (batch.empty()) return;
// ...process...
```
we should assert batch.size() > 0 after acquiring the shard lock because prefetch could have cleared it between checks. also prefer to avoid double-check idiom without memory fence.

maria: good catch, addressed with an atomic seqnum check and added comment. pushed -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4927/files#diff-...  thanks.

ci-bot: circleci/build #4927  — tests: passed ✅ (3m 42s).

cheng: ran the perf job: no regressions on p50/p99 with the new locking on a 8-GPU pool. microbench numbers: baseline 12.4ms -> new 12.9ms (samples across 10k calls). acceptable. left an approval.

sam: skimmed kernel/attn parts; no red flags from me. approved. :thumbsup:

alex: left one optional suggestion about documentation in Batching.md to call out prefetch semantics. not blocking.

maria: thanks all — merging after CI stays green. targeting merge at 17:30 PT to hit preprod window. will post if anything unexpected shows up. :shipit:

ci-bot: merge queue: mergeable, no conflicts.

maria: merged and pushed. changelog entry: "fix: prevent kv-cache prefetch/evict race causing batch reads to miss". rolling to preprod now.

cheng: will watch telemetry for 30m and report if any anomalies.

sam: nice, thanks for the quick turnaround! :rocket:
